Monthly Profitability — FY 2026/27 (April – July 2026, LKR)

Gross Profit = Revenue − Cost of Sales · Total Cost = Cost of Sales + Total Overheads − Other Income · Net Profit = NPBT − Tax Expense (fed monthly).

Budget vs Actual — July 2026 with Variance % (LKR)

Variance % = (Actual − Budget) ÷ |Budget|. For cost lines a negative variance (spending under budget) is favourable — favourable variances are shown in green, adverse in red.

July 2026 — Profit & Loss Summary (LKR)

Tax expense is fed monthly via the Tax_Expense sheet (revenue-based provision). NPAT = Net Profit Before Tax − Tax Expense.

Drag & drop the workbook here or click to browse (.xlsx / .xls) — Month as YYYY-MM or an Excel date
Expected sheets: Revenue_By_Month_Since_2020 · Actual_Revenue_2025_26_Monthly · Actual_Revenue_2026_27_Apr_Jul · Budget_2026_2027 (Revenue & CoS per SBU) · Budget_Overheads_2026_27 (monthly Admin / Mktg & BP / Finance / Other Income / Tax budget, no SBU split) · Other_Costs_and_Overheads · Tax_Expense · Customer_Metrics (optional) · Assumptions (optional).

Sheet names are matched flexibly — if a sheet can't be identified you'll be asked to map it below. All amounts in LKR; only actual revenue carries USD columns (budget & costs are LKR only). Costs are company-level monthly totals — no SBU split needed. Tax is fed monthly (revenue-based) in Tax_Expense. Churn risk is auto-computed from the 2020+ history.
